text: (オプション多すぎ問題は交渉中。。)

Elispで書かれたYAMLのパーサーだー! <https://github.com/zkry/yaml.el>
```(let ((yaml "
uri: <https://www.google.co.jp>
user: foo
password: password
"))
  (alist-get 'uri (yaml-parse-string yaml :object-type 'alist :object-key-type 'symbol)))
;;=> "<https://www.google.co.jp>"```
